# Cooling commissioning workspace

This repository records tests of the Cooling Loop And Bypass Line.
The Data Historian The
captures the operating record. The Operator Panel displays alarms.
Connect the FlowController before energising AB-200.

| Document Name | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| Cooling Loop | commissioning |
| Bypass Line | pressure checks |

See [Operating Manual](https://example.com/ControlGuide) and [report][report].
[report]: https://example.com/ReportCopy
Use `set_point` in the example configuration, not as a glossary entry.
```yaml
logger_name: HiddenLogger
```
